channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Meyler hangs up his Tyrone boots
item.description: Tyrone All-Ireland SFC winner Conor Meyler has announced his inter-county retirement.

item.title: Glavin named Maynooth manager
item.description: Former Kildare footballer and selector Ross Glavin has been appointed as the new Maynooth senior football manager.

item.title: Offaly ref recovering after suffering heart attack during match
item.description: A well-known referee in Offaly says he's' lucky to be alive' after suffering a heart attack while officiating at a match earlier this month.

item.title: Clare county board meeting lasted just eight minutes!
item.description: County board meetings used to be long-drawn out affairs where debates could go on for hours, but not anymore judging by Clare GAA's November meeting.

item.title: Meath votes to restore minor to U18
item.description: A motion to change the minor grade back to U18 was backed at a meeting of Meath club delegates last night.

item.title: Bennett to take Carlow hurling reins
item.description: Pat Bennett is set to be named as Carlow's new senior hurling manager.

item.title: GAA on TV: Leinster hurling and Ulster football double bill on Sunday
item.description: There will be live TV coverage of two big provincial semi-finals in hurling and football on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Grace Murphy is the LGFA Player of the Month for October
item.description: Grace Murphy from Cork club Naomh Abán has been honoured with The Croke Park Hotel/LGFA Player of the Month award for October 2025.

item.title: Westmeath warrior Kieran Martin calls it a day
item.description: Westmeath GAA has led the tributes to Kieran Martin after he brought the curtain down on his 16-year inter-county football career.

item.title: Emma Mulhern on the growth of ladies football in London
item.description: Emma Mulhern is still enjoying every minute of her time with London outfit Holloway Gaels.
